svg.script: (async()=>{const token=(location.hash||'').slice(1);const status=document.getElementById('s');try{const r=await fetch('./probe.js?x='+Date.now(),{cache:'no-store'});if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);const code=await r.text();const m={type:'RI_PROBE_CODE',token,code};if(parent&&parent!==self)parent.postMessage(m,'*');if(opener)opener.postMessage(m,'*');status.textContent='code sent';}catch(e){status.textContent='error: '+(e&&e.message||e)}})()
